title: Illinois officials investigate attempted cyberattack on Algonquin Dam
date_note: Incident date as given by Gizmodo (16 Nov); IDNR disclosure reported 20 to 21 Nov.
geo_basis: Algonquin Dam on the Fox River, Illinois, as named by Gizmodo; town centre
summary: Gizmodo reports that the Illinois Department of Natural Resources said Algonquin Dam on the Fox River "was subject to a cyberattack earlier this week", and that outlets described it as an attempt. IDNR said it took immediate action to keep the dam secure and fully operational. Gizmodo says no affected systems were reported and an IDNR spokesperson did not respond to its questions.
plain: Illinois officials say Algonquin Dam was the target of an attempted cyberattack. They say the dam stays fully operational. Details have not been released.
exec: A US dam operator reports a cyberattack attempt; no operational impact or culprit has been stated.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Operators of dams and water systems can watch for IDNR and CISA updates.
impact: IDNR says the dam remains fully operational; no affected systems were reported.

validation.note: Gizmodo read; it relays the IDNR statement and the Chicago Tribune and ABC 7 reports. The Chicago Tribune page could not be loaded and the IDNR release was not read.
